ADDED i1: Tests the {@link TaiInstant#ofTaiSeconds(long, long)} factory method.

The factory normalises the nanosecond adjustment into the range 0 to 999,999,999, carr
ADDED i2: Asserts that {@code ofTaiSeconds} produces an instant with the expected normalised seconds and nano-of-second.
ADDED i3: Nanos already in range [0, 9]: stored unchanged, seconds unchanged.
ADDED i4: Negative nanos [-10, -1]: borrow one second, nanos wrap up by 1e9.
ADDED i5: Nanos just below one second [999999990, 999999999]: stored unchanged.
